messages:
Liam (Data Eng): Hey everyone - planning a short relocation: I'm moving to Porto, Portugal for 28 days (2026-07-05 to 2026-08-01) to support my partner while they start a temporary fellowship. Questions: 1) Will I still receive the monthly WFH stipend for July? 2) Any payroll/tax/social security issues for a 28-day EU stay? 3) Can Facilities ship a monitor and ethernet dongle to the temporary address? 4) Anything I should do about time zones and on-call rotation?
Jordan (People Ops): Thanks for the heads-up, Liam. Quick answers: 1) We prorate the WFH stipend by days worked in the month. For a 28-day trip in July we'll calculate stipend based on days in-Portugal vs days at your homebase in the month. 2) For payroll: <30 days is generally treated as temporary; Payroll will log the trip. Please complete the short relocate/travel-while-working form and check "working abroad" so we have dates and address. 3) Facilities can arrange temporary equipment shipment; mark "temporary equipment" on the asset form. 4) Time zones: coordinate with your manager for on-call coverage changes.
Ravi (Payroll): Portugal note: for personal tax residency or social security it's complicated, but a 28-day stay is unlikely to change your personal tax residence. Company-level permanent establishment risk is low for a single short visit. That said, we need the formal form so Payroll can flag it to our global tax vendor. If you plan to work with local collaborators or be paid by a Portuguese entity that's different - let us know.
Saanvi (Benefits): Benefits remain active while traveling short-term. International telehealth may have limits; check your plan for Portugal coverage. If you need medical care there, we have pay-and-claim guidance. Also check travel vaccines and prescription shipping rules. DM me your Porto zip and I'll confirm network notes.
Mateo (Facilities): We can ship a 27" monitor + ethernet dongle. Please fill the asset/relocate form and choose "temporary shipment to EU" so we can estimate shipping time and customs. Note: for Portugal it may take 7-12 business days and recipient signature is required. Insurance for the package optional.
Liam (Data Eng): Cool. Is the stipend taxable differently when paid while I'm abroad?
Ravi (Payroll): The stipend is payroll income and taxed per your normal withholding. Short-term travel doesn't change federal/state withholding in the US. Local Portuguese tax rules could technically apply to earnings while physically present, but for <30 days that's usually not an issue. We will confirm with our tax vendor once you submit the form and check the "temporary international stipend" box.
Liam (Data Eng): Form submitted (relocate-243567). Address: Rua da Alegria 58, Porto 4000-034. Marked temporary equipment and temp-international-stipend.
legal-bot: Automated note: single employee short-term travel is low PE risk. Legal will be notified for any stay >90 days or if local contracting/data transfers occur.
Jordan (People Ops): Got the form. We'll loop in Payroll/Benefits/Facilities and get back within 48 hours. Manager please confirm coverage for on-call/timezone tweak.
Liam (Data Eng): Manager confirmed shifted daily standup to 10:30am PT during trip. Thanks y'all. :+1:
